The weighted cloud reliability calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the risk assessment logic.
The execution achieved a 1.000 mean reward across trials with zero exceptions reported in the adhoc claude-code environment. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success via test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite, passing in 0.26 seconds. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge cases in weight distribution as the judge_reward of 0.67 suggests potential for refinement in output formatting or documentation.
